unlisted_practices: Encoding clinical objectives, patient context, reasoning state and task logic in a versioned, auditable Model Context Protocol file to support longitudinal AI reasoning
Secure, documented handoff of AI responsibilities between healthcare providers via protocol files

screen.reason: The paper introduces and demonstrates a novel agentic architecture (MCP-AI) using clinical use case simulations/demonstrations, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice against a comparator.
